title: n-dimensional Hausdorff measure of balls in an n-plane
statement: Let n ≥ 1 and ℓ ∈ ℕ. Let P be a linear subspace of ℝ^{n+ℓ} with dim P = n, and let s ≥ 0. Then the n-dimensional Euclidean Hausdorff measure restricted to P gives the closed ball B_s(0) measure ω_n sⁿ, where ω_n = π^{n/2}/Γ(n/2+1) = unitBallVolume n. In Lean form: ((μHE[n]).restrict P)(closedBall 0 s) = ENNReal.ofReal(unitBallVolume n · sⁿ).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), Module.finrank ℝ P = n → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → ((μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (P : Set (Amb n ℓ))) (closedBall 0 s) = ENNReal.ofReal (unitBallVolume n * s ^ n)
